commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Portu (Girona) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
90+4' Oriol Romeu (Girona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
90+2' Endrick (Real Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Oriol Romeu (Girona) is booked.
89' Arda Guler will be replaced by Daniel Yanez (Real Madrid).
88' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
86' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
85' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Portu (Girona) heads on.
82' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Endrick (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.
81' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) replaces Federico Valverde.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ferland Mendy leaves the pitch and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) comes on.
81' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.

79' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Thibaut Courtois makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal. Girona will take a corner kick.
78' Michel has decided to substitute Donny van de Beek and he is replaced by Portu (Girona).
76' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) has received a yellow card for his foul.
76' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
76' The foul by Ladislav Krejci (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Gil Manzano.
76' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
76' Real Madrid are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. Real Madrid win a corner.
75' The attendance for today's match is 13827.
75' A corner kick by Real Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).

74' Great chance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
72' A great solo run by Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Thibaut Courtois.

69' Real Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
67' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

66' Girona show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Girona.
64' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 3:5.
62' 0 - 3 Goal Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid)! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was put through by Luka Modric and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 0:3.
61' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jude Bellingham.
60' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) replacing Bryan Gil.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Abel Ruiz (Girona) for Bojan Miovski.
57' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
55' 0 - 2 Goal! Jude Bellingham tees up Arda Guler (Real Madrid) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
54' Shots on target – 0:4.

52' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
51' Real Madrid will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
50' Girona showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
48' The players claim that Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Girona in a dangerous position.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+2' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Carlo Ancelotti, then shows him a yellow.
45+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts to discuss the decision with Jesus Gil Manzano, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+2' Girona are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
45+1' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+1' Girona show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Wonderful movement by Real Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
41' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
39' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
35' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.

34' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
33' Girona showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
31' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

30' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Donny van de Beek (Girona) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
27' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and it's Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
23' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.

21' Donny van de Beek (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Bojan Miovski, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
20' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
19' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Girona win a corner kick.
19' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
18' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) plays a one-two with Lucas Vazquez, but the move breaks down.
16' Real Madrid showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
14' Bryan Gil (Girona) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
13' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

13' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

11' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
9' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

7' Real Madrid exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a throw-in.
5' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
4' Bryan Gil (Girona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
2' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The match has just started.
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
